biggest_catch: The friend must complete specific requirements after registering with your link - registration alone earns you nothing.
catches: Referrer earns a $50 Visa Virtual Reward for each personal referral who registers with your link, opens a new eligible account, and completes all offer requirements.
A Referrer may only earn $500 in Visa Virtual Rewards per calendar year (personal tier).
Business checking referrals earn the referrer $150 per referral (referred business: new account within 180 days of referral registration + four deposits of $500+ within 60 days).
Referred person must be 18+, the primary owner of the new account, and may not have owned a Peoples Bank checking account in the previous six months.
Only one referrer may be awarded for each referred person (first link used wins).
Rewards are delivered 2-3 weeks after all requirements are completed, by email.
Virtual rewards are valid 3 months from issuance and usable at internet, mail-order, and telephone merchants.
Requires a valid U.S. Taxpayer Identification Number; rewards may be reportable as income.
Employees of Peoples Bank are ineligible.
CAP AMBIGUITY: the page's business tier ($150 per referral) sits alongside the stated $500/year referrer maximum; whether business referrals count toward that cap is not clarified.

steps: Register for the Peoples Bank referral offer on the official page.
Share your personal referral link with friends, family, or a business.
They register with your link and open a new eligible checking account.
You receive a $50 ($150 business) Visa Virtual Reward by email within 2-3 weeks (up to $500/year).
